baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal سَلَامٌ assigns safety to لَكَ, while مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ can classify the addressee with a blessed right-side cohort.
baseline_models.mechanism: Safety is predicated for the addressee, companionship makes the category durable rather than momentary, and right-sided blessedness supplies the category's favorable quality. The phrase can therefore announce a secure group-status, not merely voice a greeting.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from harm and defect supplies the concrete state assigned to the addressee.
Sustained association turns aṣḥāb into a membership class that can hold the addressee.
Blessing and good fortune give the cohort's rightward label its favorable force.

changed_reading.before: A conventional wish of peace addressed to someone.
changed_reading.after: An assurance that safety is now the addressee's condition as one counted among the blessed right-side companions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction سَلَامٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ also permits مِنْ to mark a source, making the companions agents or guarantors of the peace directed to the addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: Peace as cessation of hostility moves from a stable companion-group toward the beneficiary. The right hand's force and protective capacity make the salām a collectively backed guarantee rather than a private courtesy.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation opposed to war supplies an operative ending of threat, beyond polite speech.
Preservation through accompaniment lets the companion-group function as the guarantee's protective source.
The right hand as strength, defense, and rightful side gives the group's guarantee effective backing.

changed_reading.before: A greeting sent by a favorable group.
changed_reading.after: A collective peace-guarantee extended to the addressee by companions able to preserve and protect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence supplies a salām specifically carried by recitation, then a written form with binding force, then delivery downward. This revises the focus utterance into an authorized pronouncement whose transmitted content is the addressee's safety and cohort-status.

activation_trace.role: Concrete intactness remains the content carried by the pronouncement.
Cohort membership supplies what the transmitted assurance publicly identifies.
The branch in which a salām is read or caused to be read directly turns greeting into recited transmission.
Writing that fixes an obligatory judgment gives the transmitted salām decretive weight.
Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies the delivery path for the pronouncement.

structural_cues: 56:77-80 moves in sequence from recitation to protected writing to descent, before the focus later states salām in a compact nominal form.
The focus phrase preserves both an addressed beneficiary in لَكَ and a relation to a named cohort through مِنْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recited salām, binding writing, and directed delivery; I infer that these stages authorize and carry the focus pronouncement. A live alternative is that they frame the discourse while the salām itself remains an unmediated greeting.

changed_reading.before: A spontaneous greeting or immediate assurance at the scene.
changed_reading.after: A formally transmitted and recited verdict of safety that identifies the addressee with the right-side cohort.

context_deltas.mechanism: Life reaches its bodily endpoint at the breath-passage, an unseen nearer presence supersedes the watchers, return is challenged and fails, and repeated conditional being assigns the dying person to a class. In that mechanism salām is a performative safe-conduct across an irreversible threshold into intact blessed company.

activation_trace.role: Safety from harm supplies the protected condition asserted on the far side of the threshold.
Enduring accompaniment supplies the receiving company into which the person is classified.
Blessedness distinguishes this safe destination from the adverse class that follows.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the terminal boundary at which the assurance becomes operative.
The throat as the channel of breath localizes that endpoint in the departure of bodily life.
Unseen nearness supplies an immediate receiving presence despite the observers' perceptual distance.
Returning something to its former state supplies the denied reverse path and makes the transition one-way.
Being present in a state supplies the conditional classification immediately completed by the focus assurance.

structural_cues: 56:83-87 is an unbroken deathbed sequence of reaching, watching without seeing, nearness, and inability to return.
56:88-92 then repeats conditional class-assignment, with 56:90 naming the right companions immediately before 56:91 changes from condition to consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bodily endpoint, denied reversal, unseen proximity, and class conditions; I infer a threshold and treat salām as the effective safe-conduct across it. It could instead be only consolation after a classification already complete.

changed_reading.before: A favorable statement made after death.
changed_reading.after: The operative assurance that carries the dying addressee through a one-way boundary into protected companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adverse class immediately receives a nuzul prepared for an arrival, but its provision is hot fluid followed by contact with blazing fire. The parallel position revises the focus salām into the right companions' whole reception-package: a welcome whose substance is immunity from precisely the harms supplied to the contrasting class.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from injury supplies the positive substance of the right-side reception.
Preserving accompaniment makes the receiving cohort itself part of the hospitable provision.
Blessedness marks the reception as the positive counterpart to the following punitive arrival.
Provision prepared for one who arrives supplies the reception frame shared contrastively with the focus.
Scalding water supplies the first concrete harm from which the focus salām implies immunity.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies direct exposure as the adverse reception's second stage.
The alternate mapped root likewise contributes bodily encounter with heat, preserving the split-root evidence.
Intense blazing supplies the terminal environment negated by the right-side assurance of intactness.

structural_cues: 56:90-94 alternates class clause and consequence: the right companions receive salām, while deniers receive a prepared nuzul of hot fluid and fire.
Both consequences begin with فَ, making the opposed receptions occupy matching syntactic positions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit arrival-provision only for the adverse class and places it parallel to salām; I infer an elided positive reception-package for the right class. The live alternative is that the parallelism contrasts a spoken greeting with a material punishment without making both provisions.

changed_reading.before: An uttered welcome offered to the favorable class.
changed_reading.after: A total reception of protected arrival, companionship, and immunity, functioning as the positive anti-nuzul to heat and fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports sale, allocation, and account imagery into salām. It remains anchored in the focus transaction branch, لَكَ as beneficiary, yamin as oath, and aṣḥāb as a corporate group, while the context supplies apportioned gift, reckoning, and fixed entitlement. Render it only as a juridical-economic resonance, never as a replacement for peace and safety.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَلَامٌ can activate the transaction or advance-payment branch, and لَكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ can then sound like a benefit credited to the addressee from or among an oath-bound cohort.

activation_trace.role: Advance payment in a transaction supplies the unusual image of a secured benefit already put forward.
Stable association supplies the corporate body from which or within which the benefit is assigned.
The oath sense of yamin lets the right-side label also suggest a pledged guarantee.
An oath distributed among its people links pledged obligation with a defined participant-group.
An apportioned grant supplies the image of a benefit assigned as a share.
Accounting and recompense supply the ledger in which the assigned benefit becomes consequential.
Fixed obligation and established entitlement turn the benefit into a secured due rather than a wish.

changed_reading.before: Peace is wished for the addressee.
changed_reading.after: A pledged and apportioned settlement of safety is credited as the addressee's fixed due among the right-side companions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun salām is activated through a form-distant branch about calling an afflicted person salīm. It remains worth carrying because the branch itself holds together optimistic safety and surrender, while the immediate context stages death, non-return, and judgment. Render it as a contained echo of counter-naming at mortal extremity, not as the focus word's primary morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus سَلَامٌ retains the same root as the branch in which an injured person is named safe either hopefully or because the person has yielded to the affliction.

activation_trace.role: Optimistic naming of the afflicted, or naming surrender to the condition, supplies a tense salām spoken exactly where ordinary safety has failed.
The arrival of destruction gives the counter-name its terminal setting.
Submission supplies the branch's alternative pole: yielding rather than escaping bodily extremity.
The challenged return to the former state establishes that literal bodily recovery is unavailable.
Fate and death keep the salām's optimistic or surrendered naming inside the terminal frame.

changed_reading.before: Salām simply reports the absence of harm.
changed_reading.after: At the point of irreversible death, salām can also sound like a counter-name that declares hoped-for safety while acknowledging surrender to the passage.

strongest_changes: The Qur'an, writing, and descent sequence turns salām from spontaneous speech into a recited and authorized assurance.
The deathbed sequence turns it into safe-conduct across an irreversible threshold and into a classifying verdict.
The immediately opposed nuzul of hot fluid and fire expands salām into a whole positive reception defined by immunity from harm.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots support both a state-classification and a sourced group-guarantee, while context activates unusually precise bridges: Qur'anic recitation contains a salām branch, the death scene supplies a one-way boundary, and the punishment sequence supplies a contrastive reception. The transaction branch of salām also remains live as a tightly contained settlement resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مِنْ primarily classifies the addressee among the companions or marks the companions as the source of salām remains unresolved.
Whether salām is chiefly an utterance, a secured state, or an elided reception-package remains deliberately plural.
The settlement and terminal counter-naming readings are branch-distant and should remain exploratory rather than govern synthesis.
